send_sms.name: Send SMS
send_sms.description: Sends a text message through the device's cellular modem.

config_entry.name: Device
config_entry.description: The Zyxel device to send from. Optional when only one is configured.

number.name: Recipient
number.description: Phone number of the recipient. Anything that is not a digit is ignored.

message.name: Message
message.description: Text to send. Limited to 160 GSM characters; other characters are rejected.
